svg.title: Every layer, every time; or one pulse where it is needed
svg.desc: Two networks side by side. The left one is built in layers, with every cell joined to every cell of the next layer, and all of its connections are drawn lit. The right one is a loose web of cells that stays dark. A signal entered both. In the layered network it passed through every connection, and the line under it is full. In the web, one pulse travelled a short path of cells to the far side, and the line under it barely grew.
